Client API

group FIRMWARE_DISTRIBUTION_CLIENT_API

Client-side functions for firmware distribution.

Functions

bool fw_dist_client_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Register firmware distribution client.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where the client is registered.

  • model_data_cb -- [in] Callback function for client model data processing.

Return values:

  • true -- if registration successful.

  • false -- if registration fails.

Returns:

Registration status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_dist_recvs_add(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, fw_dist_receiver_t *precvs, uint8_t recvs_len)

Add receivers to firmware distribution server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Destination address for receiver addition.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used in addition.

  • precvs -- [in] Pointer to receivers array to add.

  • recvs_len -- [in] Length of receivers array.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Addition successful.

  • Others -- Addition fails due to network or parameter issues.

Returns:

Send operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_dist_recvs_delete_all(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Delete all receivers from firmware distribution server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Destination address for receiver deletion.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for operation.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Deletion successful.

  • Others -- Deletion fails due to network issues.

Returns:

Send operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_dist_recvs_get(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint16_t first_index, uint16_t entries_limit)

Get receivers list from firmware distribution server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Destination address for retrieving list.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for operation.

  • first_index -- [in] First index for list retrieval.

  • entries_limit -- [in] Maximum entries to retrieve.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- List retrieval successful.

  • Others -- Retrieval fails due to network issues.

Returns:

Send operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_dist_upload_start(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t upload_ttl, uint16_t upload_timeout_base, uint8_t blob_id[8], uint32_t upload_fw_size, uint8_t *pmetadata, uint8_t metadata_len, uint8_t *pfw_id, uint8_t fw_id_len)

Start firmware upload process.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Destination address for upload start.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used in upload.

  • upload_ttl -- [in] Upload TTL value.

  • upload_timeout_base -- [in] Base timeout value for upload, converted from seconds.

  • blob_id -- [in] Blob identifier for upload. Fixed 8 bytes size.

  • upload_fw_size -- [in] Size of firmware to be uploaded in bytes.

  • pmetadata -- [in] Pointer to firmware metadata buffer.

  • metadata_len -- [in] Length of metadata in bytes.

  • pfw_id -- [in] Pointer to firmware ID buffer.

  • fw_id_len -- [in] Length of firmware ID in bytes.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Upload start successful.

  • Others -- Upload start fails due to invalid parameters or network issues.

Returns:

Send operation result.

Returns:

Send operation result.
